objective: Compare the frozen static selector and M2 shadow representation through independent deterministic evaluators over exactly 420 synthetic cases, with zero allowed behavioral divergence and no active-system effects.

stage_1.purpose: Publish the human decision, granted authorization and complete brief before execution.

stage_2.purpose: Execute and publish the complete M3 dual evaluation.
stage_2.commit_message: test(lab): execute M3 dual selector evaluation

evaluation_order: Verify all frozen hashes and M2/M1A digests.
Generate and validate exactly 420 deterministic cases.
Run the static evaluator using only MODULE_SELECTOR.json.
Run the shadow evaluator using only SHADOW_INTEGRATION_REGISTRY.json and the four adapters.
Normalize result structures without normalizing behavioral differences.
Compare selected modules, order, clauses, exclusions and abstention for every case.
Verify all canonical fixture oracles independently for static and shadow.
Repeat the complete run with unchanged inputs.
Classify M3 as exact PASS or BLOCKED.
acceptance_checks: DEC-LAB-023 and authorization 157 are published before execution.
Authorization 157 is GRANTED by Jonathan Martínez before execution.
All 13 canonical fixtures pass their oracles in both evaluators.
All 420 normalized behavioral results are exactly equivalent.
Input order and duplicate signals do not change results.
Unknown signals do not activate modules.
Exclusions preserve EVIDENCE_AND_CLAIMS and remove the three excluded modules.
Two unchanged runs produce the same digest.
No active registry, selector, runtime or integration effect exists.
stop_conditions: Live HEAD differs from the granted authorization parent.
Codex is unavailable or another executor would be used.
